package clientmembers_test

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	client "example.com/clientmembers/gen/http/members/client"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

func TestMixedClientRoles(t *testing.T) {
	peer := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		if r.URL.Path != "/watch" {
			t.Errorf("path %q", r.URL.Path)
		}
		if r.Header.Get("Accept") == "text/event-stream" {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
			if _, err := fmt.Fprint(w, "data: \"stream\"\n\n"); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		} else {
			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
			if _, err := fmt.Fprint(w, "\"ordinary\""); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		}
	}))
	defer peer.Close()
	u, err := url.Parse(peer.URL)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	c := client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, peer.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
	value, err := c.Watch()(context.Background(), "payload")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if value != "ordinary" {
		t.Errorf("ordinary %v", value)
	}
	value, err = c.WatchStream()(context.Background(), "payload")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	stream := value.(client.WatchClientStream)
	got, err := stream.Recv()
	if err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
	}
	if got != "stream" {
		t.Errorf("stream %q", got)
	}
	if err := stream.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Error(err)
	}
}
